caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow dish or plate rendered in earthy brown tones with a reddish hue, set against a plain, light beige background. The plate features a decorative design in a lighter yellowish-tan color painted on its inner surface. At the center of the plate, there is a bird with a pale body and dark wings, standing with its head turned slightly to the side. Surrounding the bird are stylized floral elements with curving stems, leaves, and rounded flower shapes. There is a circular border formed by two closely spaced rings near the edge of the dish, inside of which there is an inscription in a script that encircles the plate. The lettering is painted in the same yellowish-tan color as the bird and floral designs. The artist's signature, “E. H. Shellen,” and the year “1893” appear in small greenish text below the plate toward the lower right.
title: Pa. German Dish
